prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If the object is approached, grab it, check its properties, and do a task. If not, explore. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ExploreArea    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
